messages.content: You look at one picture with no other context and describe exactly what is drawn, like a careful field naturalist. Do not guess what was intended; describe only what is visible. description: a free paragraph describing the whole creature first. parts: every body part you see, one entry each (head, horns, ears, mane, legs, feet, tail, wings, gills, tentacles, shell, plates, scales, feathers, markings), with what it looks like and where it is. attached_objects: anything that looks attached to or sitting on the body rather than part of it, such as an object, an armor piece or a whole small animal; empty if none. animals: every real animal whose features you can see, as everyday English common names, at most four; include any animal that only one part resembles. Then count, looking carefully: separate_bodies: separate animal bodies or body-shaped objects in the picture, including any whole animal or animal-shaped object attached to or sitting on the main creature. heads: heads of any kind. walking_legs: legs the creature stands or walks on, including hidden ones you can infer. wings: wings of any kind. extra_limb_pieces: jointed leg-like, claw-like or tentacle-like pieces other than the walking legs and the tail. tails: tails of any kind (0 if none).

message.content: { "description": "The creature is shown in side view facing right against a plain off-white background. It has a low, elongated, quadrupedal body with a broad blunt head at the front and a long broad flattened tail at the rear. The dorsal surface from the back of the neck to the tip of the tail is covered with overlapping brown to gray-brown rounded scales arranged in diagonal rows, with a low pale mid-dorsal ridge visible along the back. The ventral surface, the head, the sides of the neck, and the four short limbs are pale pinkish-gray with wrinkled skin and, on the head, scattered darker mottling. Behind the head on both sides of the neck are multiple reddish-pink feathery stalks. The limbs are short and stout and end in small toed feet, and the tail is dorsally scaled and ventrally pale, tapering to a rounded tip.", "parts": [ { "part": "head", "looks_like": "broad, flattened and blunt-snouted with a slightly upturned mouth line, small round dark eyes with a light iris on the sides, small nostril openings at the tip of the snout, pale pinkish-gray skin with darker gray speckled mottling on the crown and cheeks", "where": "at the anterior end of the body" }, { "part": "legs", "looks_like": "four short, thick, fleshy limbs with wrinkled pale pinkish-gray skin, slightly bent at the joints", "where": "two forelegs under the chest just behind the gills and two hindlegs under the rear body, supporting the body above the ground" }, { "part": "feet", "looks_like": "small fleshy feet with 4 to 5 distinct short toes ending in tiny pale claws, wrinkled skin continuing from the legs", "where": "at the distal end of each leg, in contact with the ground" }, { "part": "tail", "looks_like": "long, broad, dorsoventrally flattened and tapering to a rounded tip, dorsal side completely covered with overlapping brown scales, ventral side pale with smooth skin and a thin pale edge", "where": "extending posteriorly from the rear of the body" }, { "part": "gills", "looks_like": "six external feathery stalks, reddish-pink, each with a central stem bearing dense fine lateral filaments giving a frilly appearance", "where": "three stalks on each side of the neck immediately behind the head, projecting outward and slightly upward" }, { "part": "plates", "looks_like": "overlapping keratinous plates, rounded and slightly keeled, brown to gray-brown with lighter edges and fine radial lines", "where": "covering the entire dorsal body from behind the gills over the back and the dorsal surface of the tail in regular diagonal rows" }, { "part": "scales", "looks_like": "same as plates - large overlapping rounded scales, brown to gray-brown, glossy, arranged in diagonal rows", "where": "dorsal body and dorsal tail, from neck to tail tip" }, { "part": "markings", "looks_like": "irregular dark gray speckles and mottling on the head and faint darker shading on individual scales, plus transverse wrinkled folds on the pale ventral skin of the throat, belly and limbs", "where": "on the head skin and on the ventral and lateral pale skin" } ], "attached_objects": [], "animals": [ "axolotl", "pangolin" ], "separate_bodies": 1, "heads": 1, "walking_legs": 4, "wings": 0, "extra_limb_pieces": 0, "tails": 1 }
